list: The official 55 trophies: 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze; 28 of them hidden on PlayStation until earned. Names, descriptions and grades are as PlayStation publishes them, cross-checked between Exophase and PSNProfiles on 2026-11-19; the two agree on every name, description and grade.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies, PS5 (official name, description and grade as PlayStation publishes them): https://www.exophase.com/game/grand-theft-auto-vi-psn/trophies/
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies (PSN progress targets): https://psnprofiles.com/trophies/43531-grand-theft-auto-vi

roadmap.title: Opening waters
roadmap.text: Play the opening mission and Chapter 1. One missable lives in the opening stretch: have the Ocean Beach cocktail (In The Beginning…) before the story moves you on. Everything else this early is story you cannot skip past.

roadmap.title: The story: Chapters 2 to 4
roadmap.text: Work through Chapters 2, 3 and 4 and the named story missions as they unlock. Two trophies hide inside missions: make the unscheduled departure during VCIA Takedown (Catch Me If You Can), and watch for the Rhino tanks around Operation Savage Glory (Challenging Tank). Built from the official descriptions; mission replay is to be confirmed.

roadmap.title: Set pieces, then the endgame
roadmap.text: Three trophies are tied to one-off story moments — the showroom escape (Capital Offense), the partnership moment (Personal Best) and the second-try moment (Bad Luck, I Guess). Take each when its moment comes; the final mission is the point of no return, so sweep these first, then finish the story for the gold.
trophies: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

roadmap.title: The people of Leonida
roadmap.text: Finish every contact's mission strand: Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone each end in a final mission, Bret's strand ends in the unique-animal hunt, and eight finished strands earn the silver Strangers & Freaks. Start strands as they appear on the map and always finish one before judging it done.

roadmap.title: The activity circuit
roadmap.text: Sample each of the nine activity types once (Master of None), then clear the competitive set: gold medals in all 42 Shooting Range challenges, a Top Fun drone-race win at all 14 locations, 20 different race wins, Cal's fishing challenge, one arcade game, a bowling follow-through, 50 challenges and 250 stunts. Counts are the ones PlayStation tracks (PSNProfiles).

roadmap.title: Cards, calm spots and the whole map
roadmap.text: The collectible sweep, best done region by region alongside exploring all 52 areas of Leonida: 3 Collectible Card sets, all 18 meditation spots, WAiNK It at 100 locations and 100 discovered vehicles. Exploration feeds the 100% completion counter as you go.

roadmap.title: Crime pays (eventually)
roadmap.text: Free-roam feats and the money game: partner wanted-level escapes, shop and vault robberies, the armored truck, one illegal operation per gang, the Combat Focus feat, the melee drive-by, and the long counters — 500 choices, $250,000 laundered, $100,000 spent, all 8 garages bought and 10 vehicles registered on the Scooter Bros app.

roadmap.title: 100% and the platinum
roadmap.text: Close out A Long Road: the in-game 100% completion counter (PlayStation tracks it 0 to 100) is the last long pole, and most of stages 4 to 7 feed it. When the other 54 are earned, Vice Got a Price! unlocks on its own.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.when: Automatic — the moment the other 54 are earned
trophies.guide: The platinum asks for nothing of its own: it unlocks automatically once the other 54 trophies are all earned. Plan backwards from it. The long poles are A Long Road (100% completion), the collectible sweeps of stage 6 and the money counters of stage 7, so start those early and let the story carry you through stages 1 to 3 first. The order in this guide's roadmap is built from the official descriptions.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.when: Story — the opening mission
trophies.guide: Finish Gone Fishing, the opening mission. It cannot be missed and it teaches the basics, fishing among them, which Baited My Tackle builds on later. Exophase's player counts show every tracked player has this one, so simply starting the story earns it. While the opening has you near Ocean Beach, keep In The Beginning… in mind — that one can be left behind.

trophies.when: Any time — a whole-game counter, finished last
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion, the game's own counter — PlayStation tracks it from 0 to 100. Almost everything in this guide feeds it: the story, the strands, the activities and the collectibles. Do it last, use the in-game completion checklist to find what is left, and expect the final few percent to be collectibles and activity medals rather than story. What exactly the counter counts is to be confirmed in game.

trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts — PlayStation tracks the count to 250, so progress is never wasted. Stunt locations are a fixture of the series: ramps and jumps scattered over the map, each completable once. Sweep them region by region with the stage 6 collectibles rather than hunting all 250 in one sitting, and use a fast car or bike you can replace cheaply. The exact stunt list is to be confirmed.

trophies.when: Races across Leonida
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — the word 'different' is the catch, and PlayStation tracks 0 to 20. Winning the same easy race 20 times does nothing; enter a new race each time and keep a note of which you have won. Race wins also tend to pay, which feeds Treat Yo Self and the garage fund for Little Boxes.

Andy's strand also counts as one of the eight finished strands Strangers & Freaks needs. Do strands as their markers appear so none are left dangling at the endgame.

The five named contacts (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone) give five; Bret's hunting strand is a sixth; the rest are further strangers around Leonida whose identities are to be confirmed. The tracker in this guide counts the five named final missions plus Fair Game for you; chase the remaining strands on the map.

trophies.when: Free roam — with your partner beside you
trophies.guide: With your partner, reach a 4-star Wanted Level, lose it and escape. The partner condition is the only wrinkle — make sure your partner is with you before you start. Escape specifics are to be confirmed in game.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.when: Free roam — a cluster of shops, with your partner
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner, keeping the Wanted Level alive the whole run — losing the stars between shops breaks the chain. Pick three shops close together, plan the route before the first robbery, keep moving, and only escape once the third till is empty. Pair it with Hot Together in the same session: the chain robbery is a reliable way to build the wanted level that trophy then asks you to lose.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.when: Combat — any crowded fight
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies inside one use of Combat Focus. The setup matters more than the shooting: wait for a fight where five or more enemies are already grouped and in range, trigger Combat Focus, and work the group before the effect ends. Story missions with set-piece ambushes are the natural stage; if a use falls short at four, reposition and try the next crowd rather than wasting the ability on stragglers. How Combat Focus is charged is to be confirmed.
